title: Trophy Hunter
summary: Trophy Hunter is a competitive mobile hunting game developed by Ten Square Games, designed for players seeking fast-paced progression, tactical gameplay, and social engagement. Set in realistic natural environments, players compete in dynamic 1v1 matches across diverse arenas, relying on precision, strategy, and quick decision-making.
bullets: Prepared the visual foundations for the company’s new flagship project, including locations, shaders, effects, and custom tools for a global release.
Co-developed a custom lighting and shading system tailored to project needs, delivering high visual quality with minimal performance cost.
Optimized existing assets and oversaw their integration into the new project while supporting the visual side of new gameplay mechanics.
Created missing assets, extended Unity with custom tools, and trained team members to work efficiently with them.
Migrated project to URP and then to Unity 6 matching new standards of rendering in shader features like Render Graph support.

about.lead: Ten Square Games’ third hunting title – and the first built as a pure skill game, where precision, reaction time and split-second decisions matter more than exploration or resource management.
paras: Trophy Hunter launched globally on iOS and Android on July 3, 2025, after a pre-registration campaign that gathered over 500,000 players on Google Play. Matches are fast, real-time 1v1 sniper duels played over three rounds, with only three shots per duel – so every trigger pull counts.
features: Nine arenas
From Yukon, Montana and Kamchatka to the savanna, Botswana, Egypt, a deep jungle, a lost city in Burma and Java – each with its own native wildlife.
20+ weapons
Unlocked and upgraded with cards, each tuned by damage, bullet speed, zoom and slow-motion duration.
Special ammo
Four ammo types with distinct effects, such as extra damage or a score boost.
Hunter's Lodge
An upgradeable personal base that doubles as a trophy room for your best hunts.
Leagues & clubs
Seasonal leagues, global leaderboards and clubs, plus a daily Golden Shot precision challenge.

title: Real Boxing 3
summary: Real Boxing 3 emerges as a standout successor to Real Boxing 2, featuring thrilling real-time PVP combat and flawless matchmaking. With over 32,500 brawls played during its soft launch, the game demonstrates exceptional technical stability, addictive gameplay, and global appeal, poised to redefine the mobile boxing genre for players everywhere.
bullets: Established the graphics foundation for a newly developed project, ensuring high-quality visuals and performance.
Designed and implemented a real-time boxer customization system, integrating it into the game flow in collaboration with programmers and creating separate tools for game designers.
Migrated assets from Unreal Engine to Unity, utilizing URP and custom shaders to enhance visuals and optimize performance.
Developed immersive full-screen effects to elevate the gameplay experience.
Collaborated with animators, 3D artists, and 2D artists to refine visuals and maximize the impact for the project’s soft release.
Facilitated the team’s transition from Unreal Engine to Unity, providing guidance and support for a smooth workflow shift.

about.lead: The successor to Real Boxing 2, rebuilt around real-time PvP – you build your own fighter and step into the ring against players from around the world.
paras: After a technical soft launch in April 2024, the game went through a US soft launch on Android from November 21 to 30, 2024. Players fought over 32,500 bouts, matchmaking ran without issues, 95.3% of players completed the tutorial – more than in Real Boxing 2 – and over 95% of sessions were failure-free.
features: Real-time PvP
Live multiplayer bouts where timing, blocking and spacing decide the fight.
Ranked ladder
Climb ranked divisions to elite tiers and defend your spot on the global ladder.
Boxer customization
Define a fighting style, boost stats and build a signature look with unlockable gear.
Fame Road
The main progression path – from local gym hero to global superstar.
Friends & missions
Challenge friends directly and complete daily missions for rewards.

title: Super Box Delivery
role: Technical / VFX / Environment / UI / 3D Artist & Design
summary: Explore a vibrant, cartoon-inspired world, customize whimsical cars and navigate an ever-changing landscape with intuitive controls. As the delivery master, conquer challenges, earn achievements, and showcase your driving skills in this thrilling endless game. With universal appeal, it's an immersive escape for all ages.

about.lead: Super Box Delivery: Beyond the Horizon houses an expansive landscape, seamlessly navigable with engaging controls that promise boundless entertainment.
paras: Within this captivating game, immerse yourself in a vibrant cartoon realm teeming with eccentric vehicles and a kaleidoscope of customization possibilities. Become the sole guardian of punctual deliveries, facing a myriad of dynamic challenges that test your driving finesse. Navigate through an ever-shifting terrain in this gripping endless driving saga. This game boasts an array of achievements and trials, urging you to showcase your mastery amid the chaos.

title: Minigolf Adventure
role: Technical / VFX / Environment / UI / 3D Artist & Design
summary: A game sold over 400,000+ copies, multiple times reaching the top spot in Europe and ranking among the top 10 most popular games in the United States in the Nintendo Store. It offers over 200 meticulously crafted holes in four diverse environments. With captivating visuals and two physics modes, players navigate through challenging courses in five exciting game modes.
intro: In addition to defining the graphic style for the product and overseeing the visual layer of the project, I was responsible for:
bullets: Technical Artist – creating custom shaders including dynamic vegetation, stylized environmental elements, terrain effects, VFX effects, UI effects, and unique skins for golf balls, 3D/2D rendering optimizations, and fullscreen effects.
VFX Artist – preparing effects for ball interactions with the environment, 3D interface within gameplay, environmental effects, diamond collection effects, and custom force fields.
Environment Artist – co-creating environments for gameplay, optimizing created environments, implementing solutions created as a Technical or VFX Artist.
UI Artist – preparing and animating complete and consistent UI for menus, pop-ups, and gameplay.
3D Artist – creating unique track elements and 3D gameplay elements, model optimizations, creating LODs, texturing, and unwrapping.
2D Artist – preparing advertising materials based on the Unity engine and materials for use in the store or on social media: trailers, screenshots, banners.

about.lead: Minigolf Adventure, an immersive gaming experience crafted for solace-seekers and enthusiasts alike.
paras: Traversing through four distinct environments, players will discover over 200 meticulously crafted holes, each a testament to the artistry of mini-golf. The game captivates with its realistic ball physics, lending a unique character to every swing.
features: 5 diverse game modes
Arcade, High Score, Race, Hot Seat and Quickplay.
Handcrafted levels
Lush green forests, arid deserts and icy landscapes in the base game, plus Asia in the DLC – each with its own physics.
Two physics modes
Simulation, true to real-life physics, and unrealistic, where you can pause the ball mid-air and strike it in a different direction.
30 ball skins
Specially crafted skins that let players personalize their game.

title: House Fighters
role: Product Owner · Technical / VFX / Environment / UI / 3D Artist & Design
summary: Experience the thrill of childhood imagination soaring to new heights! Battle it out in epic airplane fights set within the confines of familiar household spaces. With diverse planes, an array of weapons, and daring maneuvers, enjoy endless fun and strategy for both solo adventurers and multiplayer enthusiasts. I am the originator of the project and the person responsible for the graphic style and basic design.
bullets: As the main Product Owner and creator of the title, I outlined the main game design and established the graphic style for the entire production.
Collaborated with programmers on implementing mechanics, graphic artists on asset production and consistent stylistics, and game designers on gameplay elements.
As a Technical, VFX, Environment, UI, and 3D Artist I supplemented the team by preparing elements within these roles.
Created various versions of prototypes, both stylistic and related to different environments.
Created game teasers based solely on the Unity engine and the tools available in it.

title: Maze Blaze
role: Technical / VFX / Environment / UI / 3D Artist & Design
summary: An action-packed, roguelike shooter set in ever-changing mazes infested with aliens. Every maze is procedurally generated with random layouts and adversaries, creating unique challenges. Its vibrant visuals and dynamic gameplay promise an exhilarating experience in the heart of unpredictable chaos.

about.lead: Maze Blaze is filled with endless possibilities. Lock and load, then enter at your own peril.
paras: Shoot and blast your way through alien-infested mazes in Maze Blaze, a roguelike action shooter that’s intense both in color and gameplay. Each maze is a procedurally generated level where the enemies, items, and the maze’s layout itself is random.
features: A spectacle of color
A hyper-stylized, neon-color emblazoned roguelike with visuals that are stunning yet never overwhelming.
Play your way
Clear levels and bosses, or fight through endless waves of mazes – solo or with a friend.
Maze of possibilities
Randomly generated mazes, enemies, and items make every playthrough its own.

title: Evil Lands
summary: Expansive MMORPG set in a fantasy world. Explore diverse landscapes, face powerful foes, and participate in PvP battles. Collaborate globally, customize characters, master magic and skills. Experience captivating visuals and soundscapes, rewriting the legend of an epic fantasy adventure in this ultimate RPG campaign.

about.lead: In this visually stunning and sonically captivating universe, players rewrite the legends of epic fantasy adventures.
paras: Evil Lands invites players into a sprawling MMORPG world where they step into the shoes of a Warrior, Wizard, or Assassin, each offering unique abilities and playstyles.
features: Vast, immersive world
A crafted open world from mystical forests to treacherous deserts, with 25 missions and legendary bosses.
Community
Alliances, clans and events alongside players from around the world.
Character mastery
Customization, legendary loot and combat skills for multiplayer arenas and raids.

summary: A neon-soaked pool game from Revulo Games.
